questions.question: A shopkeeper fixes the selling price of an article 20% above its cost. If the cost price increases by 20% and he increases the selling price by 16%, then his profit percentage (on the increased cost) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The initial profit = 20%

**Formula used:**

S.P. = [(100 + Profit%)/100] × C.P.

Profit% = [(S.P. - C.P.)/C.P.] × 100

Where, C.P. = Cost price; S.P. = Selling price

**Calculation:**

Let, the cost price = 100x

So, the selling price = 120x

The final cost price = 100x × (120/100) = 120x

The final selling price = 120x × (116/100) = 139.2x

The profit percentage = [(139.2x - 120x)/120x] × 100

= (19.2x/120x) × 100

= 16%

**∴ The shopkeeper's profit percentage (on the increased cost) is 16%**

questions.question: If 6 cos² θ + cos θ = 2, 0° < θ < 90°, then the value of (cosec θ + cot θ + tan θ) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

6 cos2 θ + cos θ = 2

**Concept used:**

Solve the quadratic equation by factorization method.

**Calculation:**

6 cos2 θ + cos θ = 2

⇒ 6 cos2 θ + cos θ - 2 = 0

⇒ 6 cos2 θ + 4cos θ - 3cos θ - 2 = 0

⇒ 2cos θ (3cos θ + 2) -1(3cos θ + 2) = 0 

⇒ (3cos θ + 2)(2cos θ - 1) = 0

Now, we have-

3cos θ + 2 = 0

⇒ cos θ = -2/3

But, as we know that the value of cosine function is positive in the interval 0° cosec θ + cot θ + tan θ

⇒ cosec 60° + cot 60° + tan 60°

⇒ 2/√3 + 1/√3 + √3

⇒ 3/√3 + √3

⇒ 2√3

∴ The value of (cosec θ + cot θ + tan θ) is 2√3.

questions.question: The cost price of two articles A and B is the same. Article A is sold at a loss of 24% and article B is sold for Rs. 270 more than the selling price of A. If the net profit by selling both the articles is 12%, then what is the selling price (in Rs.) of article B?

**Given:**

Article A is sold at a loss of 24% and article B is sold for Rs. 270 more than the selling price of A.

**Formula used:**

S.P. = [(100 ± Profit%/Loss%)/100] × C.P.

Where, C.P. = Cost price; S.P. = Selling price

**Calculation:**

Let, the cost price of each article = Rs. x

The selling price of article A = 76x/100 = 19x/25

The selling price of article B = (19x/25) + 270

So, (x + x) × (112/100) = (19x/25) + (19x/25) + 270

⇒ 2x × (28x/25) = (38x/25) + 270

⇒ (56x/25) - (38x/25) = 270

⇒ 18x/25 = 270

⇒ x = 270 × (25/18) = 375

The selling price of article B = [(19 × 375)/25] + 270 = 285 + 270 = Rs. 555

**∴ The selling price (in Rs.) of article B is Rs. 555**

questions.question: A dealer marks an article 40% above its cost price, and sells it by giving two successive discounts of 15% and 25% on the marked price. If he suffers a loss of Rs. 43, then the marked price (in Rs.) of the article is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount = 15% and 25%

Loss = Rs. 43

**Formula used:**

S.P. = [(100 - Discount%)/100] × M.P.

Where, S.P. = Selling price; M.P. = Marked price

**Calculation:**

Let, the cost price = 100x

So, the marked price = 140x

The selling price = 140x × (85/100) × (75/100) = 89.25x

Then, (100x - 89.25x) = 43

⇒ 10.75x = 43

⇒ 140x = (43/10.75) × 140 = 560

**∴ The marked price (in Rs.) of the article is Rs. 560**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 6,300 is divided among A, B, C and D such that the ratio of the combined share of A and D to the combined share of B and C is 11 ∶ 10 and the ratio of the shares of B and D is 8 ∶ 9. If C receives Rs. 1,560, then what is the difference (in Rs.) between the shares of A and B?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The total sum of amount = Rs. 6300

The share of C = Rs. 1560

(A + D) : (B + C) = 11 : 10

B : D = 8 : 9

**Calculation:**

A + D = (11/21) × 6300 = 3300

B + C = 6300 - 3300 = 3000

∴ B = 3000 - 1560 = Rs. 1440

Also, D = (1440/8) × 9 = Rs. 1620

∴ A = 3300 - 1620 = Rs. 1680

So, A - B = 1680 - 1440 = 240

**∴ The difference (in Rs.) between the shares of A and B is Rs. 240**

questions.question: A certain sum amounts to Rs. 14,641 in 4 years at 10% p.a. when interest is compounded annually. What will be the amount of the same sum (in Rs.) in 3(2)/(5) years at the same rate at simple interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A certain sum amounts to Rs. 14,641 in 4 years at 10% p.a. when interest is compounded annually.

**Formula used:**

A = P [1 + (r/100)]ⁿ

A = Sum of total amount and compound interest

P = The total sum

r = Rate of interest

n = Time (years)

**Calculation:**

Let, the sum of amount = x

14641 = x [1 + (10/100)]⁴

⇒ (11)⁴ = x (11/10)⁴

⇒ 1 = x/10000

⇒ x = 10000

∴ The sum of the amount = Rs. 10000

Total interest in 3{2over5} years = (17/5) × 10 = 34%

The total amount will become = 10000 + [10000 × (34/100)] = 10000 + 3400 = Rs. 13400

**∴ The sum of the amount (in Rs.) in 3(2)/(5) years at the same rate at simple interest is Rs. 13400**

questions.question: When the price of a commodity increased by 23%, a family reduced its consumption in such a way that the expenditure on it was only 5% more. By what percentage has the family reduced the consumption of the commodity (correct to one decimal place)?

questions.question: A and B run on a circular path of perimeter 1200 m at different speeds. If they start at the same time and from the same place, but run in opposite directions, they meet for the first time in 3 minutes. If the speed of B is 10.8 km/h, then what is the speed (in km/h) of A?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The total distance = 1200 m

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

The speed of B = 10.8 km/h = 10.8 × (5/18) m/s = 3 m/s

B covers in 3 minutes = 3 × (3 × 60) = 540 m

In the whole circular path, if B covers 540 m in 3 minutes. So, A has covered the remaining distance at the same time.

The speed of A = (1200 - 540)/3 meter/minute

= 220 meter/minute

= 220 × (60/1000) km/h

= 13.2 km/h

**∴ The speed (in km/h) of A is 13.2 km/h**

questions.question: To do a certain work, A is 40% more efficient than B. Working together, they can do the same work in 15 days. A started the work and left after 15 days. B and C together completed the remaining work in next 10 days. C alone can do one-third of the original work in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A is 40% more efficient than B

**Concept used:**

Time = Work/Efficiency

**Calculation:**

Let, A : B = 140 : 100 = 7 : 5

So, efficiency of A = 7 and efficiency of B = 5

The total work = (7 + 5) × 15 = 180

A complete in 15 days = 15 × 7 = 105 work

Remaining work = 180 - 105 = 75

Let, the efficiency of C = x

So, 75/(5 + x) = 10

⇒ 50 + 10x = 75

⇒ x = (75 - 50)/10 = 25/10 = 2.5

C will take time to complete one-third of the original work = (180/3)/2.5 = 24 days

**∴ C alone can do one-third of the original work in 24 days**

questions.question: The sum of 3-digit numbers abc, bca and cab is always divisible by:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The 3-digit numbers abc, bca and cab

**Calculation:**

Generic forms are:

abc = 100a + 10b + c

bca = a + 100b + 10c

cab = 10a + b + 100c

So, (100a + 10b + c) + (a + 100b + 10c) + (10a + b + 100c)

= 111a + 111b + 111c

= 111 (a + b + c)

= 37 × 3 (a + b + c)

**∴ The sum of 3-digit numbers abc, bca and cab is always divisible by 37**

questions.question: If the 9-digit number 957x5y6z3 is divisible by 33, then what is the maximum value of (x + y + z)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The given number = 957x5y6z3

**Concept used:**

**Divisibility rule of 3:** The sum of all digits of a number is divisible by 3 then the number is divisible by 3

Divisibility rule of 11: The provided integer is divisible if the difference between the sum of the digits at odd places and the sum of the digits at even places is 0 or divisible by 11

**Calculation:**

957x5y6z3 is divisible by 33

⇒ 957x5y6z3 is divisible by 3 and 11

⇒ (9 + 5 + 7 + x + 5 + y + 6 + z + 3) is divisible by 3

⇒ (35 + x + y + z) is divisible by 3 .................... (1)

Now check which option will be satisfied.

If x + y + z = 24 then (35 + x + y + z) = 35 + 24 = 59 → Not divisible by 3

If x + y + z = 27 then (35 + x + y + z) = 35 + 27 = 62 → Not divisible by 3

If x + y + z = 25 then (35 + x + y + z) = 35 + 25 = 60 → Divisible by 3

If x + y + z = 26 then (35 + x + y + z) = 35 + 26 = 61 → Not divisible by 3

So, only one option is being satisfied.

**∴ The maximum value of (x + y + z) is 25**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** According to the divisibility rule of 11

⇒ 9 + 7 + 5 + 6 +3 = 5 + x + y + z

**x + y + z = 25 **

The average weight of some persons in a group is 76 kg. If 15 persons with average weight 72 kg join the group or 5 persons with average weight 84 kg leave the group, the average weight of the persons in the group in both cases is the same. How many persons were there in the group, initially?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average weight of some persons in a group = 76 kg

**Calculation:**

Let, the total number of persons = x

15 persons with an average weight of 72 kg join the group

The average weight will reduce = [(76 - 72) × 15]/(x + 15) = 60/(x + 15)

5 persons with an average weight of 84 kg leave the group

The average weight will reduce = [(84 - 76) × 5]/(x - 5) = 40/(x - 5)

So, 60/(x + 15) = 40/(x - 5)

⇒ 3/(x + 15) = 2/(x - 5)

⇒ 3x - 15 = 2x + 30

⇒ 3x - 2x = 30 + 15

⇒ x = 45

**∴ The total of 45 persons were there in the group.**

questions.question: A race track is in the shape of a ring whose inner and outer circumferences are 880 m and 1012 m, respectively. What is the area (in m²) of the track? (Take π = frac{{22}}{7})
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The inner circumferences = 880 m

The outer circumferences = 1012

**Formula used:**

The circumferences of a circle = 2 × π × Radius

The area of a circle = π × (Radius)²

**Calculation:**

Let, inner radius = r and Outer radius = R

So, 2 × (22/7) × r = 880 ⇒ r = 880 × (7/22) × (1/2) = 140 m

Also, 2 × (22/7) × R = 1012 ⇒ R = 1012 × (7/22) × (1/2) = 161 m

The area of the track = [(22/7) × (161)²] - [(22/7) × (140)²]

= (22/7) (25921 - 19600)

= (22/7) × 6321

= 19866 m2

**∴ The area (in m2) of the track is 19866 m2**

questions.question: The monthly expenditure of a person is 40% more than his monthly savings. If his monthly income increases by 40% and monthly expenditure increases by 60%, then he saves Rs. 2,070 more in a month. What is his initial monthly expenditure (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The monthly expenditure of a person is 40% more than his monthly savings

**Calculation:**

Let his savings be 100x

So, expenditure = 140x

So, Income = 240x

Now, after increase his income = 240x × 7/5 = 336x

After increase monthly expenditure = 140x × 8/5 = 224x

So, now savings = 336x - 224x = 112x

Extra savings = 12x

According to the question,

12x = 2070

⇒ x = 172.5

⇒ 140x = 172.5 × 140 = 24150

**∴ His initial monthly expenditure (in Rs.) is 24150**
